How it works

From booking to a live tour

  1. Book & plan

    Share your space and timings on WhatsApp. We agree the areas to cover and a quiet time to shoot.

  2. Capture

    A panoramic head sweeps every angle of each spot. Most spaces under 5,000 sq ft take a single 2-to-4 hour visit.

  3. Stitch & refine

    Overlapping frames become one seamless sphere, then exposure and verticals are corrected by hand.

  4. Publish

    The tour goes live on your Google Business Profile and is ready to embed on your website.

In the frame

Spaces we bring online

What is a 360° virtual tour?

A 360° virtual tour is a walkthrough built from high-resolution panoramic photography. At each spot in your space, the camera captures every direction at once. Those captures come off the camera as circular fisheye frames; stitching joins them into a single seamless sphere, and a viewer lets a visitor look around inside it and step to the next spot.

You can see the difference between a raw capture and a stitched panorama in the comparison slider on our homepage, and explore live tours we have published in our portfolio.

Who it is for

Any business whose space helps customers decide. We have written detailed guides for resorts and hotels, co-working spaces, restaurants and cafés, clinics and hospitals, real estate, schools and colleges, wedding venues and gyms, salons and showrooms.

Pricing

Thamco360 virtual tour packages generally range from ₹5,000 to ₹35,000+. The price depends on the size of the space, the number of scan points needed, and whether you want extras such as a website embed or custom 3D features. Send us your space details on WhatsApp for an exact quote.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a 360° virtual tour cost in Bengaluru?

Thamco360 packages generally range from ₹5,000 to ₹35,000+, depending on the size of the space, the number of scan points and any extras such as a website embed or custom 3D features.

How long does a virtual tour shoot take?

Most spaces under 5,000 sq ft are captured in a single 2-to-4 hour visit. Larger properties are planned area by area and can take longer.

How soon will my tour be live?

Thamco360 deploys a crew within 48 hours of booking and typically publishes the finished tour within 48 hours of capture.

Where can customers see the tour?

On your Google Business Profile in Google Search and Maps, embedded on your website, and anywhere you share the link, such as WhatsApp or social media.

Do I need to close my business for the shoot?

No. Shoots are scheduled before opening, after closing or during a quiet window so daily operations continue as normal.
